status: Every initialized .data byte classified; all observed pointer target identities match their source initializer slots. Whole executable equality is not claimed.
scope: File-backed .data of the archive-order probe, including zero padding; loader-zero BSS excluded.

source_initializer_provenance.object_format: VC7 LTCG intermediate object; ordinary COFF symbol/addend relocation provenance is not claimed
source_initializer_provenance.method: Parse the immutable generated C++ initializer identifier lists, check every entry against separately inventoried source declarations, then require original table DWORD = original known function VA and rebuilt table DWORD = matching MAP symbol VA. Row compiled_source_line identifies the complete initializer. Preserve all known original and MAP aliases as sets.

proof_scope: Every raw initialized .data byte compared, including zero file padding; loader-zero BSS is outside this byte scope.

All 553 slots in the twelve known tables checked against the literal symbolic initializer in the immutable compiled source, separately inventoried original function identities, and both fixed/reloc MAPs.
Aliases retained as sets: no last-symbol-wins dictionary. Equal-address empty functions are not assigned a unique original source owner.
The fixed image has no relocation directory. Its companion /FIXED:NO image has independently verified identical existing sections, and each audited pointer slot has a genuine HIGHLOW relocation.

HIGHLOW proves address relocation fields, not original source-symbol spelling. Original identities and current initializer spelling are separately documented observations; this is not complete original-source provenance or whole-image equality.
Callee body reconstruction is outside this audit: matching a known target identity does not itself establish the callee body is byte-exact.
